tasks.title: Human-driven /qa smoke test: invoke /qa once against a small real change to validate the audit wiring before Ralph runs autonomously
tasks.notes: First /qa run against the project. The human stages a small real change (e.g. a CHANGELOG note or a docs fix), runs `/qa` interactively in Claude Code, and confirms: (a) the report file lands in automation/qa-reports/, (b) Codex returns a parseable COUNT_BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR/NIT trailer, (c) the report's Pass 3 section is well-formed. Do not approve the rest of the phase-1 list until this passes. If the wiring is broken, fix /qa or qa.sh first; the rest of the loop depends on this gate.
